slice: Slice 4A1R2 — Board current-state capability migration: core lineage lock + eligible universe closure
objective: Review owns the complete industry/concept board current-state analysis by consuming already-prepared First Pyramid current-state member facts. NO board capability is deleted; only migrated. Slice 4A1R fixed runtime source + ready/null semantics; 4A1R2 locks the core run identity and the eligible universe.
supersedes: Slice 4A1R (0cb9cbf0) HOLD — runtime source + ready/null semantics were correct, but two production-level UNIVERSE / LINEAGE blockers remained: (1) the exact-T loader was NOT locked to ReviewRun.source_core_run_id, so rerun/resume could silently consume another same-day succeeded/published core run; (2) the Board eligibility gate (Instrument.status == 'active', valid_for_market_aggregation) was not replicated, so the migrated capability universe was PIT members ∩ exact-T snapshot ∩ trend, not PIT ∩ active ∩ source_core_run snapshot ∩ trend. Both corrected here.

blocker_1_runtime_source.problem: Migrated Board facts were read from RawMemberFacts.flat_t. In real runtime flat_t = previous_state_to_flat(state_t) (FirstPyramidHistoryDailyState), which does NOT emit fp_trend_strength / fp_dsa_vwap_dev_pct / fp_active_ob_count / fp_sqzmom_value / fp_volume_badge / fp_volume_ratio200 / fp_volume_percentile200 / fp_latest_eqh_freshness / fp_latest_eql_freshness. Production would silently degrade to None/0 while the synthetic fixture passed.
blocker_1_runtime_source.fix: Migrated facts now source EXCLUSIVELY from the exact-T StockFeatureSnapshot.summary_payload.first_pyramid_flat already loaded by _load_current_only_snapshot_facts, carried whole as the current-only fact 'board_first_pyramid_flat' (single owner, NO second DB query). No fallback to flat_t. flat_t keeps its existing History responsibility unchanged.

blocker_2_ready_and_null_semantics.problem: Review aggregated over the whole member_list with no Board ready gate, and filtered None momentum_change / None volume_badge BEFORE taking denominators. Board producer skips non-ready members entirely and counts missing momentum_change as flat / missing volume_badge as unknown.
blocker_2_ready_and_null_semantics.fix: Added MemberObservation.board_current_ready (SSOT = FirstPyramidSemanticAdapter(board_flat).trend is not None, exact replication of the Board entry gate). compute_scope_observation derives board_ready_members and ALL 9 migrated capabilities use that universe only. _momentum_change_counts / _volume_badge_counts now receive one entry per board-ready member INCLUDING None, replicating the Board trailing else.

blocker_3_core_lineage_lock.problem: The exact-T loader locked only on (trade_date + succeeded + published), NOT on source_core_run_id. StockFeatureSnapshot's unique key does NOT include source_run_id, and the model allows multiple succeeded runs per trade_date, so Review could silently consume a different core run than the Board producer (which locks StockFeatureSnapshot.source_run_id == source_run_id). ReviewRun.source_core_run_id is a non-null immutable input identity, but the orchestrator never passed it.
blocker_3_core_lineage_lock.fix: source_core_run_id is now an explicit required parameter of prepare_current_scope_observations_batch and _load_current_only_snapshot_facts. The SQL adds BOTH StockFeatureSnapshot.source_run_id == source_core_run_id AND StockFeatureSnapshotRun.id == source_core_run_id. compute_run and resume_run both pass run.source_core_run_id; this layer never re-resolves a 'latest publication pointer'. If the specified core run's rows are absent, the loader returns empty (fail-safe) — never a fallback to another same-day run.

blocker_4_valid_universe.problem: The legacy Board producer pre-filters its flat_list through _is_instrument_valid_for_aggregation == (Instrument.status == 'active') BEFORE building the ready/missing universe and all current-state aggregation. Review consumed PIT membership instrument IDs directly with no equivalent active-status gate, so a non-active PIT member entered the migrated Board capability universe even though the Board runtime would have excluded it. The 16 parity tests could not catch this — they call compute_board_payload(flats) directly, validating aggregation-formula parity, not full production-universe parity.
blocker_4_valid_universe.fix: Added MemberObservation.board_current_eligible (single batch query, no N+1) carrying Instrument.status == 'active' exactly as the Board code does (no extra .ST/.退/delisted-suffix rules). board_current_ready is now gated on board_current_eligible first (eligible AND trend-present). The gate affects ONLY the migrated Board current-state capabilities; existing Review price / transition / historical / participation universes are unchanged. The eligible flag is injected into current_only facts (single owner, no second Board snapshot query).

parity_method: Same synthetic exact-T first_pyramid_flat member fixtures run through OLD Board producer (oracle) AND NEW Review aggregation; 9 capability groups compared field-by-field with exact count/enum/mean/percentile/histogram/latest-event/presence semantics. Review members are built through the REAL runtime path (build_member_observation with current_only[board_first_pyramid_flat]), with flat_t carrying only the partial History projection.
capability_groups: 9. latest-event snapshot state (bos/choch/ob up/down counts; eqh/eql presence counts)
board_oracle_contract: compute_board_payload iterates flat_list and builds FirstPyramidSemanticAdapter(flat) directly on each element, reading EVERY fp_* from the element's TOP-LEVEL. That element IS the exact-T first_pyramid_flat. Entry gate: 'if semantics.trend is None: missing += 1; continue'. Payload exposes ready_members / missing_members.
key_naming_note: Review exposes the migrated OB mean as structure.current_state.mean_active_orderblock_count, deliberately NOT avg_active_ob_count. PRD v2.3 formally removed Review's own 'active_ob_count' fact from the canonical Scope payload and enforces it with a whole-payload substring assertion. Slice 4A1 (f3072da9) introduced 'avg_active_ob_count' and thereby BROKE that invariant (test_canonical_scope_payload_excludes_active_ob_count was failing on f3072da9). Slice 4A1R renames the migrated key instead of weakening the v2.3 invariant, so the pre-existing regression is repaired.
schema_contract: Compatible extension only — no existing field types changed. Scope-observation groups: trend.{board_ready_member_count,trend_strength_distribution,dsa_vwap_dev_pct_distribution}, structure.current_state.{board_ready_member_count,mean_active_orderblock_count,latest_events}, momentum.{change,sqzmom}, participation.volume.{badge,ratio20_mean,ratio200_mean,percentile20_histogram,percentile200_histogram}.

boundary_cases: A. trend_direction=None with all other fp_* populated (distinctive 99.0 values) -> Board skips; Review must skip from every migrated group (numerator AND denominator). Asserted against board ready_members / missing_members.
B. board-ready with fp_momentum_change=None -> Board flat +1; Review flat_count +1 and denominator +1.
C. board-ready with fp_volume_badge=None -> Board unknown +1; Review unknown_count +1.

D. PIT member with full snapshot + trend but Instrument.status != active -> Board filters via valid_for_market_aggregation; Review must exclude it from EVERY migrated Board capability (numerator AND denominator). NEW 4A1R2.
E. all members non-active -> migrated Board universe empty (0 ready, 0 denominators). NEW 4A1R2.
